name: Druid
source: Pathfinder GM Core, "Building Creatures", Class Road Maps, via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/Rules.aspx?ID=2874
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder GM Core is ORC licensed material.
rules: High Perception; high Nature, moderate or high skill from order; high Wis; high Will; low to moderate HP; low accuracy; high to extreme spell DC. Abilities: Prepared primal spellcasting as a druid of their level; order ability, order feats, and order spell for their order; Shield Block; add an animal to the encounter for animal order

notes.skills: High Nature; a moderate or high skill from its order.
notes.defense: High Will; low to moderate HP.
notes.spells: High to extreme spell DC. Prepared primal spellcasting as a druid of its level: {maxrank}. Order spell.
notes.specials: Order ability and order feats; Shield Block; add an animal to the encounter for animal order.
